issue.title: Fix private cross-file imports in the split bead sync modules
issue.description:
Discovered by epic land agent sase-f2.land while running the mandatory 'just check' on master 15e4213cc during the sase-f2 landing. Not caused by sase-f2: the working tree was clean and sase-f2 touched none of these files.

Commit 15e4213cc 'refactor(beads): split sync implementation into focused modules' (agent bbugyi200.athena.toobig-1j.split_file.src.sase.bead.sync.0) split src/sase/bead/sync.py into _sync_publication.py, _sync_refresh.py, _sync_logs.py, and _sync_diagnostics.py. Symbols that were file-local privates in the original sync.py now cross module boundaries, so Symvision rejects them.

Reproduce: just install && just _lint-symvision  (or 'just check', which fails at the lint (symvision) stage after fmt/keep-sorted/ruff/mypy/pyscripts/changelog all pass)

  Error: Private functions/classes should not be imported. Make these public if they need to be imported by non-test files!:
    _AsyncPushHandle in src/sase/bead/_sync_publication.py
    _BeadStoreRefreshError in src/sase/bead/_sync_refresh.py
    _PushOutcome in src/sase/bead/_sync_publication.py
    _SyncLogOutcome in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _bead_sync_log_dir in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _classify_sync_error in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _git_state_path in src/sase/bead/_sync_diagnostics.py
    _has_push_remote in src/sase/bead/_sync_publication.py
    _head_is_published in src/sase/bead/_sync_publication.py
    _normalize_logged_repo_root in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _normalized_path_string in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _parse_sync_log_outcome in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _read_sync_log_records in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _recent_bead_sync_log_paths in src/sase/bead/_sync_logs.py
    _semantic_beads_dir_for_sync in src/sase/bead/_sync_publication.py

Impact: 'just check' is red on master, so every agent required to run it before replying is blocked on an unrelated failure and must adjudicate it by hand.

Not a duplicate of sase-dm ('Fix private Symvision import in bead plan links'), which was closed as canceled and concerned a different symbol (_hierarchical_id_key) in a different module; the same defect class recurs per file split. Not owned by active epic sase-ej either: its Symvision findings were stale --epic-symbol whitelist entries for the enqueue_* publication symbols, already resolved by 234e8175c.

Scope: per sase/memory/symvision.md, either stop importing these across files or promote the ones a real non-test production consumer needs to public names (each promoted symbol then needs a genuine non-test consumer). Keep the existing sync facade and monkeypatch-compatible API that 15e4213cc preserved. Verify with 'just _lint-symvision' and a full 'just check'.
